name: cpuinfo
title: Audio CPU load panel (debug)
summary: Debug: shift + speech opens a full-screen panel with the audio CPU load measured on the device: the CYCLES spent inside TE's audio block callback vs the time between blocks (average, peak per 0.25 s, worst since opening, ~37 s history graph), the share of our SDK engines (enginehost), the core clock implied by the block period (at 44.1 kHz) and the PLL / voltage registers as programmed. The first opening wraps TE's audio callback pointer and enables the cycle counter if it was off; nothing runs before that.
controls: shift + speech: panel on / off (the first opening starts the measurement)

evidence.what: device (op1cpu): CCLK 400.0 MHz at 44.1k, CLKIN 25.0 MHz, PLL_CTL 0x2000, VR_CTL 0x70b0, CCEN was on; audio load 25-30 % most synths, dsynth up to 60 %, peak about +5 %; SDK engines 10-15 %, MALLET 18.7 %

status_note: device 2026-11-14: CCLK 400 MHz (CLKIN 25 MHz, PLL_CTL 0x2000 = MSEL 16), CCEN already on; loads plausible
